{"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"decision","text":"The voice records described each principal once. The model now holds how each voice changes: a speech process for Babbage, Lovelace and Halden with dated episodes, each linked to the scenes it is heard in and to its causes, and a register reading of each episode. Babbage moves from grievance and principle (1843) through silence at the trial (1851) and the enterprise voice (1852) to defence of the trace (1854) and clipped directions in his last autumn (1871). Lovelace moves from conditions (1843, 1844) to the short commands of illness (1851) and a divided voice at Ockham (1852), spare with William and figurative about the Engine. Halden moves from plain trade speech (1843) to borrowed grandeur as manager (1852) and back to the ledger (1854). The narrator's register is a telling process over the chapters. Passages declare which episodes they render, so a later change to a modeled voice flags the lines that carry it."}
nodes.title: Voices modeled as processes that change over time

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"plan","text":"Develop the existing native knowledge/work processes from the accepted prose and Events, preserving the whole life and the venture’s known service-capacity failure. The book already shows supervised source uncertainty, later self-comparison in an overloaded office, silence before the employer, reciprocal corrective reading, and a request for the full account in a reference. Add bounded native subevents and explicit contextual relations where those actions remain buried in aggregate Events. Preserve context-dependent recurrence: the 1852 lesson neither guarantees later interruption nor creates an independent checker. Considered an authored competence score; a single increasing scale would conflate source independence, audible intervention, employment authority and technical qualification, so qualitative distinctions are more useful for this question. No new incident, numerical allocation, chronological outcome or completed personality transformation is needed. The model can distinguish an observed action from the modeler’s explanation of it. Nora’s material attention and unsettled_account are already carried by the strip, pencil, ruler and fresh sheet; preserve their scene-specific use instead of adding an explanatory moral. Leave unobserved origins, gaps between scenes and later mastery open. Parent process origins remain unknown; a history of later responses must not be loaded into Wills’s knowledge at birth."}
nodes.title: Wills: learning to interrupt without becoming an independent checker

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"interpretation","text":"A modeler’s reading of the unchanged passages, not an extra thought silently assigned to Wills. In January 1852 “I cannot read that one” is followed by Neale’s “Nor can I”: source uncertainty becomes a permitted question. In April 1854 a second person is unavailable and self-reading fails to provide independent evidence; this does not erase the lesson. In the May inquiry “The clerk said nothing” leaves the reason for silence unsettled. In reciprocal correction “The one before, Mr Neale” succeeds only after a soft request fails, a pencil stops the copy, and Neale returns to the figure. Before departure “Only the other part as well” asks an employer to preserve his own authorization alongside Wills’s error. These are different relationships to a question and its audience, not one steadily growing quantity. The new personal subevents make those distinctions inspectable beneath the existing work/knowledge whole."}
nodes.title: What changes when Wills can stop the work?

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"revision","text":"The revision check flags the preceding development plan because the knowledge/work Event descriptions it discusses were expanded. Reviewed: the plan is retained as a historical statement of intended work, and this note records its completion. Four native personal subevents now open the accepted lesson, self-comparison, inquiry and reciprocal correction; the existing reference request stays in place. Four explicit renders declarations were added after proposal review, with every previous declaration retained. The prose, reading order, scene disclosure claims and three telling-process tracks remain unchanged; their quoted passages still support the current readings. The fresh model-depth assessment covers this changed model. Do not infer a continuous numerical trajectory, independent checker qualification or complete learning history from this repair. No other parent-world values, numerical Cuts, scene outcomes or coordinates were changed. No additional prose was needed: Nora’s material attention is already enacted in the source passages."}
nodes.title: Development plan reviewed against the accepted refinement

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"question","text":"The existing episodes support several possible openings. Does Wills’s silence before Halden arise mainly from dependence on a future reference, shame about his own error, fear of naming the authorizer, or another reading of that encounter? The manuscript does not settle it. Which part of reciprocal checking transfers to a new workplace when Neale is absent: source separation, a stopping gesture, confidence that a request will be answered, or none reliably? Does requesting a fuller employment reference alter later conduct, or remain a local success? These are possible next investigations, not missing quotas or authorization to invent the answer now. Obtaining the original specimen and later independent qualification also remain unknown. A useful subsequent scene could test one relationship rather than declare a cured personality."}
nodes.title: Where can Wills interrupt, and what makes a question safe enough to ask?

{"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"voice","text":"Babbage speaks in long, qualifying sentences with sardonic asides: at committees, at the Treasury's economy with words, at Clement keeping the tools, at the members of both Houses who ask whether wrong figures give right answers. He enumerates (the store, the mill, the reading of the cards), keeps his grievances in writing ('I have the drawing to prove it'), and is funny at other people's cost. He is formal and never uses contractions. When he is hurt he drops to one short sentence ('The recurrence is exact.'). The documented positions are developed inside the scenes, not quoted: the wrong-figures question returns in XI as his fear of what people will say. Grounded in his modeled life (the withdrawn government support, the Clement dispute, an Engine that exists most completely in his mind) and in the voice of his own prose."}

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"voice","text":"Halden speaks like the estimator he is: plain words, contractions, sums, the bill and the wages. He asks what a thing weighs, where it stops and who pays. His jokes are short and dry ('Twenty-five pounds.'). He is not an aphorist: where he states a principle he states it as a price. The ledger voice of Chapter I stays his ('We sold four dates with hands for two.'). Grounded in his modeled life: twenty years of railway and instrument supply, drawings that lied by silence, a household with a school fee and two unpaid accounts."}

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"voice","text":"Lovelace negotiates in conditions, as her letter of 14 August 1843 does: if, then, and exactly what is being paid for. When she thinks about the Engine she turns figurative, in the manner of her Notes and of what she called poetical science (the loom that weaves flowers). She applies mathematics to people ('each becomes a function of the other two') and mocks her own fame ('I have been said more about all my life'). Her sharpness comes through questions and conditions rather than the narrator's aphorisms. Illness shortens her sentences in VIII and X, and the scene with William stays as it is."}

nodes.text: {"schema":"meaning-model-understanding-note/v1","kind":"voice","text":"The narrator keeps its exact, dry intelligence and its best closing lines ('Monday had filled itself before it arrived.', 'A reasonable wrong answer recruited the reader.', 'The mechanism's resistance entered Farrow's life first as Friday.', 'The machine offered no judgment on the route not taken.'). It gives up five closers that only restate what a scene has shown: the risk Lovelace knows and Babbage's laughter in II, the assurance office surviving eloquence in IV, the knowledge that purchased coal in VII, and proof and failure beneath one fastening in XII. More of the book's wit now belongs to the people who speak."}
