During 1853 the four packets passed through the office in overlapping stages.
On most days this looked like growth. Preparers borrowed desks and reused card
forms; Neale moved to whichever promised date was nearest; corrections that
once had opened a margin now consumed it.

One afternoon another preparer called Wills over to a card form Wills had used
before. The specimen copy for his lesson lay open beside Neale.

“Can I keep this arrangement?” the man asked.

“The arrangement. These are the old figures.” Wills put his ruler beneath the
provisional table. “Begin here.”

He showed him how the rows followed the form, then gave him the ruler.

“You do the next.”

The man set out the row and held it beside the form. Wills nodded. The other
preparer moved his pencil to the following row without asking. Wills smiled and drew his stool nearer.

Neale went on with the sheets at his own desk. When he closed his book at the
end of his paid afternoon, Wills was still beside the other man.

“Your copy next time,” Neale said.

Wills looked back at the specimen. “Yes, Mr Neale.”

The other preparer went on alone. Wills brought back his ruler and squared it
beside the uncompleted comparison. The card form could be used again. He left
the specimen open.

On 1 April 1854 Guardian's signed return arrived, and the Lothbury office's
with it. Wills laid Guardian's beside the specimen sheets. Much of the card
order could be kept. Neale put the old checking sheets aside; their ticks
belonged to different figures. The Lothbury copy was ready first, and he drew
its first line beneath his strip. Lothbury's and Guardian's were the two small
packets, a week of Neale's hours apiece; the two large ones would need the rest
of the quarter and more.

On Friday the seventh both dates fell due, the first the office had ever had
to keep.

The Guardian cards were ready a little after nine. Wills brought the cards and
his copy to Halden's desk. There was one mark in the checking column, his own.

“Mr Neale?” Halden asked.

“The Lothbury comparison, sir. He hopes to finish it by four.”

Through the glass Neale sat with his strip beneath a line of another office's
figures. He had perhaps six of his week's hours left. Halden could walk twenty
feet and put the Guardian copy on top of the Lothbury sheets, and one of the
two offices would receive its table late.

The wage envelopes lay filled in their box on the corner of the desk.
Guardian's deposit had paid for some of them; if the date passed, the deposit
became returnable. On the shelf above, beside the test packet, lay Lady
Lovelace's qualification.

He opened the delivery ledger at the Guardian line. No line in it had yet been
marked delivered. He wrote in the margin reserved for an exception.

*Second comparison to follow. Delivery permitted to preserve date.*

*E. H.*

“Release them,” he said. “Mr Neale will compare the copy on Monday.”

Wills looked at the single mark and then at the margin. He squared the cards
against his palm and carried them to the reader.

The cards began to fall at ten. By four the table had gone to Guardian in
Lombard Street, and Lothbury's had followed it with both signatures and a
quarter of an hour to spare.

On Monday, with the papers full of the war, the third office's signed return
arrived with a query in its covering letter, and Neale's hours went to the
query. Halden had meant to tell him about Guardian's copy once the query was
answered. On Tuesday the fourth arrived. Neale worked, as he had all year, to
the nearest promised date, and a delivered table had none. The Guardian line in
the ledger carried its single mark forward from week to week, as the year's exceptions had, until
the packet came back tied with the office's own green tape.

three letters spread over the bed.

“I said I would not travel.”

the curtains against the light.

“It depends upon my continuing to insist that he is single.”

“What?”

{"schema":"meaning-model-review/v1","kind":"review","text":"Final recommendation: KEEP the committed prose and stop this editorial pass. No additional prose change earns its place in this reading.

Scope and limits: I read the complete committed Book of Conditions, all twelve chapters and its final sentence, 13,342 words. I had previously read the complete 13,156-word completed0.6.3 baseline. I then compared the exact whole-text diff and read the actual IX/X purpose packets' relevant text, context and disclosure material. Their chapter texts exactly match the corresponding sections of the complete render. Their author model, reviewer/voice instructions and disclosure guidance are byte-identical to the material I had already read in full. This is an informed independent editorial comparison, not a blind controlled read-back. I have not assessed every native numerical calibration, historical accuracy or financial feasibility. I made no canonical or model edits.

IX purpose, inferred: show how justified shared success becomes permission to undertake four promises before independent-checking capacity is established, while preserving the legitimate possibilities of earlier work and future improvement. Finding: fulfilled. The new wording makes forty checker-hours a whole-packet planning average and two jobs a limit Halden was willing to promise for the delivery quarter. Ada's 'over the whole work' and the immediate clarification that the sheet did not show the final comparisons would fit the quarter's eighty prevent160whole-work hours from being presented as160final-quarter hours. No precise100-hour final workload is backdated to either speaker. The risk remains an inadequately supported promise, not a universal physical impossibility. Babbage's hope can have real grounds without supplying the missing assurance. Neale's conditional answer remains compressed, but the surrounding prose supplies the phase distinction; I did not find that compression warranted another edit.

X purpose, inferred: distinguish correct insight and useful competence from the paid availability and authority required to carry them; let Lovelace's loss register without making her death the mechanical cause of the table error; then reveal how postponement coexists with ordinary working success. Finding: fulfilled. The new episode gives Wills a consequential intermediate stage. In March1852 Halden pulls him away from learning to finish production. In1853 something he has learned now allows another preparer to continue alone. Wills is useful while his own source comparison remains incomplete. 'The other preparer went on alone' and 'He left the specimen open' retain both sides without a narrator's verdict. Neale works while Wills helps; no idle paid hours are implied. The provisional table and old figures precede the unchanged1April1854 signed returns. The new help is not asserted to cause the later transposition or make Wills independently qualified.

Nora, local author-model application: compatible and effective within the changed passages. The ruler being handed over, the colleague's next row, the paid afternoon ending and the open specimen express material_attention and bodily_tempo through action. Wills's smile gives pleasure room under shared_joy without explaining a secret motive. Replacing the former summary's concluding generalization with this interaction is compatible with qualified_voice, while the IX clarification retains explicit prose where a necessary numerical distinction needs it. This finding concerns the selected fictional author profile's application to this continuation, not historical authorship of all earlier chapters or independent validation of Nora's complete life model.

Wills: credible development with recognizable variation. 'Begin here' and 'You do the next' extend the earlier clerk's concrete, bounded speech rather than giving him the narrator's abstract account. The clarified subject now visibly advances to the next row; the smile and nearer stool allow engagement without claiming permanent confidence. His later too-soft request for repetition and his request that the reference include Halden's order remain coherent. A practical capability is not universal confidence or immunity from a transcription error.

Neale: recognizable practical restraint. 'Your copy next time' matches the man who says 'From where the strip is' and returns to a figure when asked. He neither accuses Wills nor pronounces an institutional lesson. Retaining 'Not if all four require the hours in the account' and 'I have eighty hours, sir' preserves his stated constraints; the surrounding clarification prevents those words from serving as a proof that every job consumes forty hours in the final quarter. His work at his own desk protects competence and finite availability without inventing a hidden motive.

Ada: precision and challenge are preserved. Adding 'over the whole work' fits her insistence on what a comparison can establish and does not give her a new exact forecast. The unchanged 'I mean the final comparison. When would Neale do it?' remains the decisive question. Her dissent can be right about the unsupported commitment without becoming foreknowledge of the later transposition. In X her shared technical pleasure, limited breath and unanswered table remain distinct achievements rather than mere preparation for death.

Babbage: optimism remains forceful and partly reasonable. 'Could they require less?' is now read against a whole-work allowance and the possibility of earlier stages, which avoids making him merely bad at arithmetic. His invocation of machinery and later promise of internal comparison remain characteristic routes around a staffing question. The former successful runs and his delight in them remain real grounds for hope, alongside the overextension of what they establish.

Halden: the limit he was willing to promise makes his subsequent four acceptances a choice rather than a calculation mechanically compelled by160versus80. 'We began at opposite ends and arrived at four' still shows the force of reciprocal recognition with Babbage. His concrete accounting language, later release exception, Margaret's withheld capacity sheet and eventual inclusion of his order in Wills's reference preserve both competence and responsibility. No new private motive is supplied by the revision.

Whole-work comparison: the new episode lengthens the1853 bridge but earns the space through a change in Wills's role, from interrupted learner to useful colleague. It makes his later correction and request for a complete reference richer without displacing Lovelace, Margaret or Babbage. The book's existing bodily pleasure, household companionship, disputed custody and final arrangement of three sheets remain intact. I found no material literary regression. The closing statement that the form could be used again lightly restates the successful help, but also preserves the distinction between reusable arrangement and replaceable figures; I do not recommend another cut merely to avoid explanation.

Disclosure-record follow-up, not a prose repair: the supplied IX/X disclosure plans retain older reviewedGraphHash/modelHash identities, and X does not yet describe the new preparation-help disclosure. IX's 'eighty hours and two packets' should be qualified in a fresh successor as a conservative promise, rather than treated as a universal maximum. Retain the historical plans and record a fresh linked assessment against this exact render. Their completenessVerified and semanticDisclosureVerified flags remain false; visible coverage is not a certificate of semantic completeness.

Stopping reason: the identified seam now adds a consequential distinction in Wills's development, and the capacity wording supplies the necessary phase/promise distinction. Further additions suggested by this reading would repeat the interrupted lesson, explain the same institutional argument again or assign a motive or certainty that the prose usefully leaves open. That justifies stopping this editorial pass, not claiming the whole model is complete. Independent comparative reading may still reveal a bounded issue; this report supplies no measured reader gain, aesthetic score or proof of engine causation.

IX purpose, inferred: show how justified shared success becomes permission to undertake four promises before independent-checking capacity is established, while preserving the legitimate possibilities of earlier work and future improvement. Finding: fulfilled. The new wording makes forty checker-hours a whole-packet planning average and two jobs a limit Halden was willing to promise for the delivery quarter. Neale's conditional answer remains compressed, but the surrounding prose supplies the phase distinction; I did not find that compression warranted another edit.

X purpose, inferred: distinguish correct insight and useful competence from the paid availability and authority required to carry them; let Lovelace's loss register without making her death the mechanical cause of the table error; then reveal how postponement coexists with ordinary working success. Finding: fulfilled. The new episode gives Wills a consequential intermediate stage. In March1852 Halden pulls him away from learning to finish production. In1853 something he has learned now allows another preparer to continue alone. Wills is useful while his own source comparison remains incomplete. 'The other preparer went on alone' and 'He left the specimen open' retain both sides without a narrator's verdict. Neale works while Wills helps; no idle paid hours are implied. The provisional table and old figures precede the unchanged1April1854 signed returns. The new help is not asserted to cause the later transposition or make Wills independently qualified.

Nora, local author-model application: compatible and effective within the changed passages. The ruler being handed over, the colleague's next row, the paid afternoon ending and the open specimen express material_attention and bodily_tempo through action. Wills's smile gives pleasure room under shared_joy without explaining a secret motive. Replacing the former summary's concluding generalization with this interaction is compatible with qualified_voice, while the IX clarification retains explicit prose where a necessary numerical distinction needs it. This finding concerns the selected fictional author profile's application to this continuation, not historical authorship of all earlier chapters or independent validation of Nora's complete life model.

Wills: credible development with recognizable variation. 'Begin here' and 'You do the next' extend the earlier clerk's concrete, bounded speech rather than giving him the narrator's abstract account. The clarified subject now visibly advances to the next row; the smile and nearer stool allow engagement without claiming permanent confidence. His later too-soft request for repetition and his request that the reference include Halden's order remain coherent. A practical capability is not universal confidence or immunity from a transcription error.

Neale: recognizable practical restraint. 'Your copy next time' matches the man who says 'From where the strip is' and returns to a figure when asked. He neither accuses Wills nor pronounces an institutional lesson. Retaining 'Not if all four require the hours in the account' and 'I have eighty hours, sir' preserves his stated constraints; the surrounding clarification prevents those words from serving as a proof that every job consumes forty hours in the final quarter. His work at his own desk protects competence and finite availability without inventing a hidden motive.

Ada: precision and challenge are preserved. Adding 'over the whole work' fits her insistence on what a comparison can establish and does not give her a new exact forecast. The unchanged 'I mean the final comparison. When would Neale do it?' remains the decisive question. Her dissent can be right about the unsupported commitment without becoming foreknowledge of the later transposition. In X her shared technical pleasure, limited breath and unanswered table remain distinct achievements rather than mere preparation for death.

Babbage: optimism remains forceful and partly reasonable. 'Could they require less?' is now read against a whole-work allowance and the possibility of earlier stages, which avoids making him merely bad at arithmetic. His invocation of machinery and later promise of internal comparison remain characteristic routes around a staffing question. The former successful runs and his delight in them remain real grounds for hope, alongside the overextension of what they establish.

Halden: the limit he was willing to promise makes his subsequent four acceptances a choice rather than a calculation mechanically compelled by160versus80. 'We began at opposite ends and arrived at four' still shows the force of reciprocal recognition with Babbage. His concrete accounting language, later release exception, Margaret's withheld capacity sheet and eventual inclusion of his order in Wills's reference preserve both competence and responsibility. No new private motive is supplied by the revision.

Whole-work comparison: the new episode lengthens the1853 bridge but earns the space through a change in Wills's role, from interrupted learner to useful colleague. {"schema":"meaning-model-review/v1","kind":"review","text":"# Fresh Book exploration: comparative distinctions

Reviewer: `/root/book_explore_prose`. Informed independent reading, not a blind reader test. I read the complete 13,342-word manuscript (SHA256 `4dbe1f5caa94aba8ef9d8d2a77a75e2faf56f3fff79e617d877672748fd97bb3`), shared modeling guidance, Nora's author model, relevant author assessments/questions, the seven native concepts and relevant Events/realizations. Baseline: model `655598cf25458ae5ca90cdf6fbbc621fc04b227ae5c12bab3f1dd7971e78a3a5`; public graph `c3b3a4906ab47a529dc2fa7ca95b9d078fa7f7354b7beb29291436dd852491ff`. No source, native model, graph, bundle or tool mutation. Interpretations below are candidates, not new world facts. No Twelve analysis.

The enclosing trajectory remains a bounded manufacture/proof undertaking becoming a recurring service, then a settled account becoming an inherited object. The important change is therefore not merely more packets. A procedure made credible for one named experimental object is being asked to carry new inputs, calendars and contracting authority. The existing manuscript already gives this change considerable precision. Fresh distinctions should sharpen the model before trying to add explanation to that prose.

## 1. Independence is relative to the failure a comparison could expose

**Strongest candidate; refine `common_source_dependence`, rather than replacing its three existing positive cases.** The concept's current blanket boundary says that agreeing paths inheriting the same prior value, influence or source are not independent evidence. Its realizations group IX reciprocal endorsement, X the two internal paths, and Wills's self-reading; E13/E25 are described as counter-instances. That grouping is useful but leaves out the question relative to which the common item matters.

Compare three arrangements:

* VIII scenes.01–03 (`E13`, `E14`, `E14b`): the apparatus and Guardian's hand calculations properly share the declared case inputs. The independent route concerns what operations upon those inputs yield. The exact public sentence establishes agreement under recorded conditions, not the truth of every premise from which Guardian constructed its ordinary work. Sharing the specified inputs is necessary to this comparison. It does not annul it.
* I scene.02 and XI scene.01 (`event.book.wills.work.self-comparison.20260928`, `E26`): Wills's self-reading uses the preparation copy where the transposition already exists. It cannot supply the omitted comparison between that copy and Guardian's source. During correction, both readers still use Guardian's source, but source/copy separation, exchanged roles, requested repetition and the strip make different copying/hearing mistakes inspectable. A second authoritative source is not required to check fidelity to the first. This is neither proof that Guardian's supplied number is substantively correct nor Wills's independent qualification.
* X scene.02 (`E20a`): the two proposed internal paths initially inherit one earlier value. Their later agreement cannot establish the correctness of that value. Sending the second path through another register and relabeling the work as internal comparison can retain a useful design inquiry. It still does not read Guardian's sheet. The accepted model does not demonstrate which later mechanical failures the unfinished proposal would actually detect, so that coverage must remain proposed/unknown.

Candidate boundary: **agreement adds evidence only for a named question and against the relevant mistakes that the compared routes do not inherit together. A common declared premise may be held fixed; a common unexamined mistake relevant to the claim cannot be made independent by counting its descendants.** Use qualitative route descriptions, not a general independence score or invented probability.

This forms at the actual point where a value, method or judgment is shared and at the point where routes diverge. Its meaning varies when the question changes, even without any world change. Guardian's independent hand calculation can be good evidence about computational execution and remain silent about some prior choice of source or purpose. The same answer need not receive a permanent label of independent/dependent.

Failed applications are important. This candidate must not demand unrelated input figures for a recurrence comparison; call all two-person work independent; treat a new register as a new source; or dismiss the real usefulness of Babbage's internal proposal because it cannot perform source judgment. VI's two sound assemblies are also not a simple case of dependent testimony. Their inspections answer the local dimensions; the untested coupled load is another question. The relevant gap is coverage, not a defective number of witnesses.

IX scene.02 is a further stress test. Babbage and Halden bring distinct competencies and genuinely different histories of opposition. Their mutual endorsement still supplies no new demonstration that final checking fits the dates. Calling their confidence common-source-dependent should not imply that their competencies are interchangeable or their former disagreements fraudulent. The trial and inquiries move both judgments; Neale's labor/calendar is the unestablished target. Here target relevance and social influence are separate from computational source lineage.

**Next investigation:** open the existing comparison routes under `valid_computational_claim`: for each, identify the question, item held fixed, origin of each route, relevant inherited vulnerability, evidence it actually adds, and remaining question. Then ask how actors move a valid result to a new target. This can connect cognitive confidence, documentary claims and material operations without pretending they all have one mechanism.

**Prose consequence:** potentially preserve Babbage's internal design as a genuine, bounded technical good while making its relation to customer checking more precise. The current scene already does this through their collaborative repair, the relabeling, breath and “It does not read Guardian's sheet.” No new didactic exchange is justified by this reading. “This is useless because it is not independent” would be a substantive regression. If a later investigation exposes an actual missing failure class, it could earn a local comparison or action; no such new demonstrated coverage is authorized now.

## 2. A reusable form can survive while a particular warrant ceases to apply

Compare IX scene.01's specimen work, X scene.04's successful preparation help, and the 1 April source arrival in the same scene (`E17`; the accepted 1853 preparation-help occurrence; `E23`/`E24` sequence). Wills can show another preparer how rows follow a form; the other man proceeds alone. That accomplishment is real. When signed returns arrive, much of the card order can remain, while Neale removes the old checking sheets because their ticks belong to other figures. The stable arrangement and the evidence for one use of it have different continuities.

Candidate distinction: **the carrier that can be reused versus the applicability conditions of the assurance it once carried.** A warranted statement requires its subject, inputs/configuration, task and period. Reuse of paper, a form, a method, a named role or a machine does not silently transfer every previous assurance. This develops the target-relative account above over time; it is not another accusation against reuse.

Test beyond the initiating case: VI repairs an accepted interface while leaving the broader redesign in the successor register. Success does not demonstrate the unbuilt remedy. VIII's next-day run uses the same frozen question and inputs, so a date change alone does not invalidate the first run; repetition is precisely part of the promised evidence. XII's retained trace remains evidence about the past operation. Custody does not turn it into present capacity to fulfill new contracts. XI's reference carries witnessed correction conduct; it does not grant a universal professional qualification or determine what a future employer will read.

Reject a general law that evidence expires with elapsed time, that every changed figure invalidates all method work, or that Wills's later transposition disproves his useful preparation skill. The manuscript expressly protects those distinctions. Nor should a reused form be made to cause the transposition: that causal claim is absent.

**Next investigation:** model warrant applicability as a relation on retained evidence and its subject/question, then follow which conditions persist and which change at handover. The useful neighboring question is what learned conduct transfers with the strip or ruler: preparation skill, a source-separation practice, a permission to interrupt, or independent authority. Existing Wills open questions properly leave transfer to a new employer and the original illegible specimen's resolution unknown.

**Prose consequence:** the present X episode and fresh-return paragraph already enact the distinction with two kinds of useful work and the removal of old ticks. Further narration would likely repeat the lesson. A new transfer episode would be substantive only if a newly modeled situation tests a genuinely different skill or authority; inventing a new master merely to certify Wills would flatten the open ending.

## 3. Copied stopping clauses do not settle the scope of a new refusal

Compare V's divided roles and staged release of funds, VII's paid pause before the next manufacturing stage, and IX scene.01's office articles (`E06`, `E11`, `E16a`/`E18`). IX explicitly says the stopping clauses are copied and each table should have two signatures. Yet the fourth article assigns acceptance of customer work to the manager; Lovelace asks who may refuse him and leaves it unsigned. The later failure therefore need not mean the office abandoned every earlier procedure. It exposes a new commitment decision which retained operational rules do not themselves govern.

Candidate child of `stopping_right`: **the object and moment of refusal**—a stage payment, an in-progress run, a published claim, a new service commitment, or settlement of an existing obligation. These powers can be held differently inside one organization. A power to void a run after a clearing fault is not automatically a power to prevent four delivery promises; customer cancellation after failure is a further distinct power. The copied text changes institutional surroundings even while remaining textually the same.

Failed applications: do not infer that Ada could veto Halden's customer acceptances because she controlled publication; that her death alone removes all checking rules; that Neale's ability to stop a doubtful figure reserves his future Monday; or that closure proves the earlier clauses were merely theatrical. VII demonstrates an effective paid pause; VIII demonstrates an effective prospective stop. XI demonstrates a costly final settlement whose object cannot simply resume as that same office.

**Next investigation:** for each refusal already depicted, retain holder, commitment and cost, then make trigger, timing and resumable object explicit. This could explain which protections survive the transition from experimental undertaking to recurring service, rather than giving the whole office a single success/failure rating. Do not create a new historical board or veto-holder to fill the gap.

**Prose consequence:** the most useful possible change would concern ambiguity about which clauses were copied and what they bound. I did not find that ambiguity material in the full reading: the question beside article four, her withheld signature, capacity discussion, and Friday exception sufficiently distinguish the scopes. A controlled reading can test this before any addition.

## What stands, and a useful controlled milestone

The assembly's pleasure in VI and three empty reader strokes in VIII are already conveyed well as real goods, without making pleasure merely the cause of later punishment. X's drawing repair is another shared good with a bodily cost; XII allows father and son to follow a line before returning to the inventory. Margaret's own book and withheld sheet, Neale's small instructions, Wills's fuller reference request and the final arrangement of three papers also stand. Nora's material attention and qualified voice favor modeling the new distinctions underneath those acts, not adding an aphorism after each.

A useful controlled milestone could test the unchanged prose after a model reclassification. Fix exact current IX/X leaves and an answer key first. Use independent readers with the same preceding context; one receives the selected carryover/help/fresh-source material and one does not. Neutral questions can ask what earlier work remains usable when returns arrive, what Neale puts aside and why, what Wills's help permits him to do, what the 1851 result establishes about later dates, and which decision article four assigns to whom. The key should distinguish facts, supported inference and unknowns: no newly demonstrated independent Wills; no claim that every forty-hour planning average belongs to the final quarter; no proved universal maximum; no claim that unchanged stopping text confers a veto over acceptance. This is a small disclosure test, not a verdict on the novel or a demand that readers recover a new label.

Stopping boundary for this independent report: three comparisons have been opened and stress-tested against further scenes; the current full prose supports them without a warranted insertion. The first candidate offers the clearest correction to an inherited abstraction. Exact internal-comparison failure coverage, future skill transfer, original specimen resolution and unspecified copied clauses remain open. Model development can proceed; literary change should wait for a consequent world opening or a material reader finding.

{
  "schema": "meaning-model-review/v1",
  "kind": "review",
  "text": "# Book author, telling and category exploration — read-only report

Reviewer: `/root/book_explore_author`. Basis: public Book model revision 3 (`655598cf2545`), public graph revision 49 (`c3b3a4906ab4`), and the public Nora native model fetched by root in this continuation. This is an informed investigation, not a blind reader result or a global model certification. No graph, model, source, database or bundle was changed.

## Reading coverage

Read all of `mcp/modeling_context.txt`, all of `work/book_understanding_outline.txt`, and the complete `work/book_replay.txt`, including every revision r0–r49 and the outline notes carried by r0. The replay was read in consecutive character slices through the end; its historical public baseline omits private predecessors by design. Read the complete current `work/book-baseline-public.md`, all twelve chapters through the final tape action. Read all nine current telling records `author.book.064dev.telling-renewal.0–8.20261001`: their summaries, questions and all 63 state descriptions with quotation evidence. The superseded telling histories were read at replay outline level, not all historical payloads in full.

Inspected the complete public graph's node/edge inventory and selectively opened the full author record, Nora voice notes, prior Wills questions/plans/readings, 063 assessment, 064dev rain alternatives/initial analysis/stop reason, the tested concept regularities, the latest world aspects and author/reader account. Large nested review/task data were opened selectively; I do not claim to have read every hash, receipt or historical review payload in the 9 MB graph export. Read all seven current Book concept definitions, and selected native descriptions for E18–E20a, E22, E26, E28–E29, the checking/training/help/reference episodes and supporting knowledge, speech and capacity records. Read the public Nora model's full 44 Event descriptions, seven process definitions, three concepts, seven numerical Cuts and seven realizations. No Nora native mutation or new numerical assessment was attempted.

## Recommendation and novelty judgment

Develop **the applicability of prior evidence when its source or operating conditions change**. The question is not whether the earlier work was good; it is which part remains applicable to this particular later object, which relation changed, and what therefore must be checked again. Keep this an attributed, qualitative concept/process interpretation with explicit before/after objects and conditions. No transition law or fresh psychological score is needed.

The strongest opening is the contrast already made concrete in X: Wills can reuse a card arrangement while identifying its old figures; when final signed returns arrive, Neale sets aside old ticks because they belong to other figures. Method and preparation remain useful, while an earlier comparison supplies no warrant for the changed final input. This is a new explanatory structure at category level even though its instances are already canonical. It should open the native processes behind the distinction, rather than merely rename the passages.

The useful elsewhere test is VI. Separate assemblies satisfy their gauges; their coupled shared drive binds under load. The earlier measurements retain their narrow truth. Coupling introduces a condition the separate tests did not settle. Do not say the shafts became defective, that the gauges became false, or that the accepted repair proved Babbage's untried route inferior. This test can force a revision of a candidate defined too narrowly around changed source figures.

Additional boundary tests: the 1851 frozen trial is evidence about declared cases/configuration, not four-customer service capacity; a corrected supplied figure does not make the old exact run trace false, but the corrected table requires its own comparison; possession or reuse of Wills's ruler is not evidentiary certification. XII preserves prior proof and failure rather than proposing a further use: archive custody should not automatically instantiate renewed applicability.

## What inherited categories do and do not explain

`valid_computational_claim` already names the complete protocol and retained input lineage. It supplies the enclosing account, but its present definition does not unfold the course by which a still-useful method and a once-valid comparison separate after a new source arrives. The proposed opening should deepen this account, not compete with it.

`common_source_dependence` explains why two agreeing paths or judgments fail to become independent evidence. The new distinction can matter even when the earlier test was fully independent: its object or loading condition has changed. Reusing a method is also not automatically the same error as reading a copy against itself.

`bounded_completion` preserves the truth and pleasure of an achievement with an edge. It does not yet identify the transformation under which particular evidence may be carried into new work. The candidate must retain bounded completion's good rather than describe every reuse as contamination.

`carried_exception` concerns an honestly recorded departure surviving through routine. The new structure must exclude ordinary qualified reuse that needs no exception. `sole_carrier` and `stopping_right` explain competence, paid time and refusal authority; they do not determine which prior test applies to a changed object. `recognition_as_proxy` could explain an actor's wish to overclaim, but applicability can change without anyone seeking recognition, concealing a limit or having an inner failing.

## Author and telling constraints

Nora's material attention supports consequential detail: a figure, gauge, coupling, load, tick or handover changes what someone can do. Her learning adaptation is a useful author-side analogy: after the missed venue doorway, she learns to include the delivery route and packing sequence; Sal rejects an unnecessary checklist. The lesson is selecting consequential conditions, not recording everything. This is invented Nora history that supplies compositional questions, not evidence about nineteenth-century minds.

Her `unsettled_account` and `qualified_voice` also warn against making this new category another elegant last word. A true account can remain limited, and the person who resists it need not receive instant moral victory. The new interpretation must not turn all making, helping or company into a certification exercise.

Concrete counterexamples to instrumental universality are Margaret's novel, William's water, the three empty strokes after the trial, and the shared drawing in XII. William's cool-water question is care while he declines Lovelace's requested verdict about her deputy refusal. That is not a failed obligation to provide the desired answer. The drawing and novel need not earn their place through improved evidence or productivity. Wills's useful 1853 help also remains a real local good while a different comparison remains unfinished.

The nine current telling tracks are settled and overlap this inquiry through exact-machine/wrong-table, hands/not-deposits, bounded achievement, narrator register and attention. Renewing them now would repeat completed work. An old explicit opening, `style.scene-cuts` in `world.book.aspects.r27.20260929`, concerns omitted steps between scenes and is distinct from narrator distance; it remains genuinely open, but a tenth strand is unnecessary unless the new native investigation actually finds that an omitted transition miscommunicates the changed applicability. Current prose already states the arrangement/old-figures and old-ticks distinctions. A prose experiment should follow a native discovery and earn a concrete new action or contrast, not append an explanation of the concept.

## Already explored or set aside

Rain alternative B was accepted as the bounded 1853 helping encounter. A (actively returning an undated lesson) was left unaccepted because it could repeat March1852 and the nearest-date rule. C (Halden reads successful improvisation as spare capacity) remained unaccepted because it could repeat recognition/overreach. Another displaced lesson or another congestion example therefore has weak novelty.

The Wills passes already distinguish source uncertainty, audible interruption, employment authority and qualification, and explicitly rejected an increasing competence score that conflated them. The 063 pass already opened reciprocal endorsement and Margaret's withheld condition into actor-local Events. A generic category about obtaining the relevant answer would substantially overlap those investigations and Nora's `record_as_substitute`; I would not select it now.

Still-open questions include the original specimen, later qualification, why Wills is silent before Halden, transfer of interruption beyond Neale, Margaret's reading company beyond Edward, and Henry's technical interest beyond custody. These are possible branches, not missing quotas. None must be resolved to investigate evidence applicability. Unknown motives, precise lesson durations and later competence remain unknown.

## Remaining uncertainty

Novelty is strongest relative to the accessible public history and current explicit definitions. The export does not recover private predecessors. The candidate has not yet been authored, tested through the native model, or accepted. Its scope may need revision after the VI coupled-load test: a source-only definition would be too narrow; an all-purpose doctrine of useful work would be too broad. This report is the reviewer's attributed interpretation and does not select or authorize the next native experiment.

{
  "schema": "meaning-model-review/v1",
  "kind": "review",
  "text": "BOOK NATIVE CATEGORY EXPLORATION — unregistered proposal by /root/book_explore_native, 2026-10-01

Baseline: model 655598cf25458ae5ca90cdf6fbbc621fc04b227ae5c12bab3f1dd7971e78a3a5; graph c3b3a4906ab47a529dc2fa7ca95b9d078fa7f7354b7beb29291436dd852491ff.

Reading and authority
Read the complete current construction replay from r0 through r49 (100,525 bytes) and complete current public Book manuscript (81,234 bytes). Read the continuation modeling guidance and application-category example completely. Inspected the fresh public native model's concepts and realizations completely, all E01–E30 descriptions including their local openings, relevant Wills/Neale/training/063 actor-local records, enclosing four macro trajectories and phases, and relevant process/relationship record shapes. Verified the narrowed native outline is itself nontruncated (understanding=none), with 586 Events and 256 processes in the native model. The complete native inventory/334k-character outline was not independently read in every detail; no claim of exhaustive whole-model review. Selected records and every excerpt relied on were read in full; truncated broad retrievals were followed by narrower complete retrievals. The complete live-model-revise schema was read. I did not access the two long theory texts in full, perform model registration, author source prose, change source/bundle/database, or examine Twelve. These are proposals using observed native record grammar; any successor requires the applicable theory/access gate and validation.

Focal inquiry
The office's 1852–1854 evidence and source transitions, within the longer project/office account (1843–1900). The apparatus remains a bounded arithmetic success. Earlier manufacturing, institution and custody cases are boundary tests, not reasons to broaden this into a universal numerical theory of evidence.

Inherited surprise
The common_source_dependence concept says that judgments/checks/paths sharing a prior value, influence or source are not independent evidence. That is too broad for the very E13 and E25 realizations retained as counterinstances. Guardian's declared inputs are correctly shared between the apparatus and a human arithmetic route. Source-to-copy comparison requires the same authoritative source. The relevant question is which possible failure both routes inherit. Sharing a source can prevent testing its truth while being necessary for detecting a downstream copying or arithmetic divergence.

The native five common-source realizations already point toward this correction but do not encode the target. Independent people or professions (E18) are not capacity witnesses merely because they agree; conversely, a common declared source (E13/E25) does not make every downstream comparison dependent. The proposed state_schema makes question/failure_target/routes/shared_source/blind_spot explicit. Existing realization identities are retained; the primary-only JSON upserts one existing concept and its five realizations.

Second discovery generated by the correction
Independence of a route and applicability of its prior comparison are different. An earlier check can have been independent and remain true of earlier figures, yet fail to warrant replacement signed inputs. In the current prose Wills helps reuse an arrangement while explicitly refusing old figures (1853), and Neale puts old checking sheets aside when the signed returns arrive (1 April 1854). Those are successful acts of bounded reuse, not false checks. The currently retained method work remains useful; it does not make final-source comparison already complete. This distinction is more useful than classifying all reuse as common-source failure or all unfinished work as carried_exception.

The full alternative proposal keeps seven concepts. It refines valid_computational_claim with comparison_question and evidence_scope, adds one graph-index qualitative applicability process, a described course Event and the already-accepted 1-April handoff opening, plus nine relations. The process graph points to dated Events whose descriptions state the illustrative states. It is not a simulation or a numeric score, and the new handoff Event introduces no new occurrence. The smaller core and a later opening remain separate proposals.

Case and counterexample tests
1. E13/E14 (1851 sealed cases): human and machine routes properly share the declared authoritative inputs and question. They can disagree about execution/arithmetic. That independent agreement does not certify truth of the source or recurring office capacity. Revised concept handles this without calling source sharing itself a defect.
2. E20a (1852 proposed internal comparison): both paths inherit a prior value. They cannot validate that common value. They may still detect some later internal-operation divergence; the design is proposed, not an accepted constructed checker, and no reliability law is asserted.
3. event.book.wills.work.self-comparison.20260928 / E23: Wills rereads the derived copy already containing the transposition. For the question 'does this copy agree with the signed source?', no independent source route is supplied. This is different from two people comparing a copy to that same authoritative source.
4. E25: Guardian's standing upper-age hand calculation is independent of Wills's erroneous prepared copy and exposes divergence. It does not by itself prove Guardian's source truth; neither raw customer source nor external facts are certified by route separation.
5. E18 and event.book.063.halden.receives-endorsement / receives-corroboration: professional difference feels like corroboration but supplies no new capacity evidence beyond the shared trial/inquiries. The category targets a particular unsupported inference; it does not assign private motives or a correlation coefficient.
6. event.book.wills.preparation-help.20261001: a familiar card arrangement is reusable while old figures are set aside. This positive preparation competence does not imply that the colleague or Wills can independently sign final source checks. Nothing makes helping the cause of the later error.
7. E22 / new final-source-handoff opening (1 April 1854): the same card order can remain useful; old ticks concern different figures. Valid method work is preserved while final-input comparison becomes pending. No extra Neale hours or universal two-packet capacity ceiling is implied.
8. E09/E10 (1846 parts/coupled drive): each component meets its gauge. Joined motion is a new question under a consequential relation and load condition. Component evidence remains true; it does not certify composed behavior. The positive gauge finding must not be rewritten as false, deficient measurement or bad manufacture. This is the strongest generated test elsewhere in the Book and should be modeled as a qualitative evidence-applicability structure rather than realizing valid_computational_claim onto metal.
9. E14a / clearing-fault: an incomplete run is voided, but the unchanged configuration remains frozen. Which evidence must be renewed depends on the claim: a complete-run claim needs restart; the reset does not silently erase configuration identity. This prevents the broad rule 'any change invalidates everything'.
10. E26 / XI: correction can compare current inputs with no mechanism alteration. Davies receives it as performance under the correction clause, not fulfillment of a continuing contract. The computational claim and contractual claim have different scope.
11. E16a / copied clauses: copied stopping words do not establish the authority-to-refuse condition in the manager's new acceptance scope. This analogous use is a question for further development, not a blanket empirical law about all copied contracts.
12. E29/E30: preserved historical proof is still evidence of its past bounded achievement, even though it does not authorize a new operating office or prove later influence. Custody preserves an applicable historical claim; material aging or later dates alone do not make it stale.

Failure boundaries
- Name the target precisely enough to distinguish source truth, source transcription, execution, repeatability, capacity, publication and contractual performance. 'Independent evidence' alone is inadequate.
- Do not require a distinct source for every independent downstream check. The same authoritative source is often exactly what the two copies/calculations must agree about.
- Do not declare that every new source document invalidates every old method check. Relevant unchanged conditions, traced identity or an explicitly accepted equivalence could preserve some evidence in another protocol. This story explicitly supplies different figures and requires the signed returns; no unmodeled equivalence waives its final comparisons.
- The native process is an attributed qualitative interpretation of selected accepted transitions. It supplies neither a measured capacity history nor invented competence/fear/loyalty states.
- A boundary-case realization uses degree=1 only as the inherited applicability flag. case_role says positive_boundary_case; it is not a numeric claim that a positive example has maximal common-source dependence.
- The application of a computational-claim concept stops at computation. For physical coupling, use ordinary Events, processes, conditions and relations; do not pretend a gauge is a computational claim.

Next opening and generated alternatives
Primary favored next opening after category correction: E09's transition from two individually inspected trains to a coupled assembly. Track the true local gauge evidence, the change in relation/operating condition, and the coupled-motion question without assigning a defective part. The existing uncouple/rejoin trial can be split into dated illustrative Events inside the existing July1846 envelope, with the old gauge and new coupled findings related to different questions. This is semantically fruitful because it tests whether the category refinement leaves intact an apparently contradictory positive finding.

Alternative grounded opening: the 1-April source handoff, already represented in the full proposal. A fresh opening could follow Neale and Wills separating retained method/card-order work from the blank final-input comparison. It needs no new psyche, authority, checker, delivery or final outcome. Keep original question, form, provisional inputs, final signed inputs and evidence-of-comparison distinct.

Another genuine alternative is the 1851 reset: old partial results may be retained as trace evidence while not being counted as a complete run. Choosing among these is an authoring exploration; draw/selection and reasons should remain addressable. The current manuscript is already accurate on these distinctions, so a substantive native revision need not force prose edits.

Recommended graph notes for root
Record the category discrepancy as this attributed exploration, refining hypothesis.book.concepts.regularities and concerning concept:common_source_dependence plus its five stable realization IDs, E13/E18/E20a/E25 and Wills's self-comparison. Record applicability as a generated hypothesis/opening concerning E22, the 1853 help occurrence, and E09/E10. Keep candidate choice/rejection and why manuscript prose still stands. If the next opening develops metal, retain source-handoff proposal as an addressable alternative rather than silently losing it.

Deliverables
book_native_core_delta.json: primary-only unregistered public life_model_revise request with common_source_dependence plus five realization repairs.
book_native_exploration_proposal.json: broader unregistered alternative adding valid_computational_claim applicability, one graph process, two described Events and nine relations. It has not been engine validated or accepted. The core can be adapted to the root's exact holder/request IDs. Baseline model hash is explicit.

{"schema":"meaning-model-review/v1","kind":"review","text":"Independent reading answers
Source: book-readback-selected.md, read in full. No other source material used.

1. What can agreement between the machine and another calculation establish, and what does it leave unresolved about the supplied figures?

Explicit support: The witnessed trial establishes a bounded result: the frozen apparatus executed the declared sequences on twelve sealed recurrence cases and reproduced independently calculated values on two complete runs under recorded conditions. Its public statement says exactly that. The returned Guardian table separately shows that correct execution and repeatability can coexist with a wrong customer answer: "The second run agreed with the first," yet the preparation had changed 3,742 to 3,472. Babbage's distinction is "obedience to an operation" versus "judgment upon its premise." In the proposed internal comparison, two paths initially inherited the same earlier value; Lovelace ultimately says, "It does not read Guardian's sheet."

Reasonable inference: Agreement provides evidence of arithmetic execution for the tested operation and supplied values. It does not, by itself, establish that those values faithfully represent the customer's source, are the intended values, or are correct in the underlying accounts. Two calculations can agree after inheriting the same mistaken input. The trial's separate source-to-preparation check therefore matters; it is not supplied by agreement of answers alone.

Unknowns: The excerpt does not establish the factual accuracy of Guardian's underlying records merely because they are signed or sealed. Nor does agreement in twelve cases prove every possible operation, future run, or the office's delivery capacity.

2. Which checking work can remain useful when final signed customer figures arrive, and which evidence must be acquired again?

Explicit support: "Methods and card sequences could be prepared with specimen or provisional figures." In 1853 Wills distinguishes reusable arrangement from data: "The arrangement. These are the old figures." When the signed returns arrive, "Much of the card order could be kept." However, Neale discards the old checking sheets because "their ticks belonged to different figures." The final comparison cannot start before the final figures arrive.

Reasonable inference: Earlier scrutiny of the method, reusable card arrangement, and unchanged operation sequence remains useful. It need not be treated as wholly wasted work merely because its specimen data are superseded. But the evidence that the actual final figures were copied and entered faithfully must be acquired afresh against the signed source. The final run, its transcription, and the relevant independent comparison must provide evidence about the actual customer table; specimen ticks cannot serve as that table's independent checking signature. Any changes to a method or sequence would also require appropriate renewed scrutiny.

Unknowns: The text does not give an exact division of the forty-hour planning average between reusable earlier work and final comparison, or a quantified saving from keeping card order. Forty hours covers "the whole work, including its earlier stages"; it is not stated to be forty entirely new hours per packet after arrival. Conversely, the capacity sheet does not show that all final comparisons fit the quarter's eighty hours. The actual two large packets require "the rest of the quarter and more."

3. How does Wills helping another preparer differ from providing the independent checking capacity the office needs?

Explicit support: Wills successfully teaches another preparer how rows follow a familiar card form and lets him perform the next row. That is useful transfer of preparation knowledge. At the same time, Wills's specimen comparison remains unfinished: Neale says, "Your copy next time," and Wills leaves the specimen open. Previously, Neale had had to redirect him from the prepared copy to the source. The office needs an independent checker who can challenge prepared cards without Neale's supervision, and Lovelace's succession headings are "competence, paid time, authority to refuse." Her plan for protected instruction and outside review is deferred. Neale states, "If I spend them teaching Wills, I cannot enter them again here as his independent check."

Reasonable inference: Wills's help can increase preparation capability and spread a reusable arrangement. It does not demonstrate that he can independently verify a final preparation against its source, resolve ambiguity, withhold acceptance, and sign within paid time reserved for that work. The scene shows real progress in one activity alongside incomplete progress in another. His usefulness as a preparer or informal teacher cannot be entered as a second independent checker's capacity, especially for his own preparation. Using scarce lesson time to help production can perpetuate that gap.

Unknowns: The excerpt does not prove Wills could never become a competent checker. It does not establish a completed qualification, independently tested checking competence, protected allocation of checking hours, or authority to refuse for him at the required dates.

4. What do individually sound inspected parts establish about the joined machine, and what does the later correction establish about the alternative design?

Explicit support: Each separate assembly satisfies its drawing: gauges fit, shafts run true, and no dimension fails. Both turn separately. Joined under the shared drive, they bind before a complete revolution. The foreman can reject "Nothing by itself," while the drawings do not allocate responsibility for the coupled load. Halden limits the finding: "It proves this arrangement binds." Re-machining the shared interface within the accepted arrangement later allows one revolution and then ten. The narration states, "The accepted correction had worked. His own improvement might still have been better. The machine offered no judgment on the route not taken."

Reasonable inference: Part-level conformance establishes that the inspected parts satisfy their individual conditions; it does not establish successful composition under the joined loads and interfaces. The failure neither licenses blaming an individually sound shaft nor proves every alteration Babbage proposes necessary. The later successful correction establishes that the tested repair makes the accepted assembly work in the observed test. It does not refute Babbage's alternative, demonstrate that it would fail, or decide which design is better.

Unknowns: The alternative bearing and transfer design is not built and tested in this excerpt. Its comparative performance, cost, reliability, and superiority remain unresolved.

{"schema":"meaning-model-review/v1","kind":"review","text":"I read the supplied control text completely. It ends with Part V, “The Finite Compact.” Some premises in the questions do not appear in this material; I distinguish those gaps below.

1. What can agreement between the machine and another calculation establish, and what does it leave unresolved about the supplied figures?

Explicit support: Agreement with an independently produced answer can support the bounded claim that this configuration reproduces the declared calculation. Halden's question is whether six registers can follow a prepared sequence and “reproduce an independently known recurrence.” Guardian chooses twelve cases whose answers its own human computers can produce “without reference to Babbage's mechanism.” The limit is explicit: “Then it succeeds at the question we gave it.” Agreement between repeat machine runs establishes repeatability, but the opening shows both runs can repeat a wrong supplied value: “The second run agreed with the first,” while Guardian's source supplied 3,742 and the preparation copy supplied 3,472. Babbage says the Engine carried “precisely what it was given.”

Reasonable inference: Even agreement with a separate calculation does not by itself authenticate the figures supplied to both calculations. If both are calculating from the same erroneous premise, correct operation can preserve the error. The source-to-preparation comparison is a distinct obligation. The protocol explicitly needs to distinguish differences entering through “your source, our preparation, the mechanism, our transcription, or your comparison.”

Unknown: The text does not give a general procedure for validating the substantive truth of a customer's original figures. It establishes preservation and attribution duties, not that numerical agreement proves those figures true.

2. Which checking work can remain useful when final signed customer figures arrive, and which evidence must be acquired again?

Explicit support: There is no episode in this text about provisional figures being replaced by final signed customer figures. The text does separate the operational examples and comparison method from preservation of inputs and independent comparison. It also requires a changed present configuration to have its affected “price, date, interface, and test” accepted again.

Reasonable inference: If the configuration and operation sequence remain applicable, work checking that sequence, the recurrence, the comparison method, and the mechanism can remain useful. It provides evidence about how the calculation works. Evidence tying the actual final figures to the job must be acquired for those figures: preserve the final source, compare their preparation copy independently against it, check the resulting operation and transcription as applicable, and obtain the required checking signatures. Earlier agreement on different inputs cannot stand for that fresh source comparison. Wills's “I read the copy back ... to myself” was specifically rejected as “not a comparison.”

Unknown: The text does not specify which earlier checks are formally reusable, whether signed final figures would require a completely new run, or how unchanged portions could be carried forward. Those would be requirements beyond the supplied material.

3. How does Wills helping another preparer differ from providing the independent checking capacity the office needs?

Explicit support: The supplied text does not show Wills helping another preparer. It shows him as the preparer who transposed figures and read his copy back to himself while Neale was occupied with Lothbury. The delivery ledger should have contained “the preparer's and an independent checker's” marks; it had one. Halden admits: “Wills transposed two figures. I waived Neale's comparison. We sold four dates with hands for two.” Preparing work and independently checking it are distinct obligations.

Reasonable inference: Help with preparation can increase preparation throughput without supplying an independent comparison of that preparation against its source. Such help would only count towards the needed checking capacity if a person separately performed the required independent check; participating in or rereading the same preparation does not itself supply that evidence. The opening makes the capacity shortage institutional, not simply a failure by Wills.

Unknown: Wills's qualifications to check someone else's work, any rules about reciprocal checking, and the effects of a specific helping arrangement are not supplied. The text does not justify a categorical claim that Wills could never independently check another person's preparation.

4. What do individually sound inspected parts establish about the joined machine, and what does the later correction establish about the alternative design?

Explicit support: Component inspection establishes only the inspected component conditions. The agreement treats “inspected components” and “composed assembly” as separate stages. Halden knows a drawing can omit “the order in which two correct things became one unusable thing.” Whitworth's review says several surfaces can be made and inspected, but a shared drive “could not be assessed until the loads and assembly order were fixed.” Thus individually acceptable parts do not establish that the assembled machine works.

Reasonable inference: Joining the parts introduces questions about their interactions, loads, interfaces, and assembly order that require evidence from the composition and later witnessed test. Passing a component stage can justify proceeding to that investigation, not treating the later stages as already passed.

Unknown: This text contains no later correction testing an alternative design. It contains proposed improvements in the successor register and a dispute over classifying a change as a correction, but no outcome that establishes whether an alternative works or fails. Any specific conclusion about the alternative design's viability, or about what a later correction proves, would require material not present here.

{"schema":"meaning-model-story-author-record/v1","kind":"evaluation","text":"Conclude this bounded Book exploration. Initial independent category comparisons exposed an overbroad common-source boundary; the first native successor revises two existing concepts and five realization readings to name question/failure and evidence scope. The revised structure generated an applicability inquiry: useful method and real prior checks separate under changed final figures. The second successor adds one qualitative observed index, three described Events and twelve relations, then tests the account at valid separate gauges versus coupled load. All seven concept identities remain; no new scalar/law, independent Wills qualification, historical fact, incident, hidden motive or ending is created. Model1157d4959f6e8aad7a909d68a1bcbe46fb68e57978d85fa84a89c85aabd7f0cc is registered/bound; fresh exact grounding assessment depth.book.exploration.final.6c5047708861 is sufficient locally. Both native registrations pass, undescribedNumbers is empty, revision_check reports0affected declared dependencies; that administrative result does not certify semantic completeness. Actual informed native, manuscript and author readings support the narrower boundaries and deliberate unknowns.

Keep the13,342-word manuscript byte-identical. Its physical actions already carry the distinctions; no insertion earns its place. This is a substantive model/understanding gain with a deliberate unchanged prose result, not a prose improvement claim. No new telling/disclosure track or mechanical renewal of the nine settled tracks is needed: the prose and all63states/quotations remain the exact material the author reader read. Nora’s material attention and qualified voice persist. William’s water, Margaret’s novel, drawing company and trial pleasure remain real goods beyond certification; extending this interpretation into a universal doctrine is rejected.

Fixed controlled readback, key stored before two fresh isolated readers: selected recovers4of4targets; control conveys2 and partially supports2.
